text: そんなに　タマゴ　かえしてるんだー　ほんと　かえしまくりだなー　きみ！

structure.jp: そんなに　タマゴ　かえしてるんだー
structure.en: so you've hatched that many Eggs

structure.jp: ほんと　かえしまくりだなー　きみ！
structure.en: you really are hatching them like crazy!

patterns.name: 〜まくる
patterns.explanation: まくる stuck onto a verb says it is done again and again without holding back; まくり is its thing-like form used with だ. かえしまくり = 'hatching like crazy'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ (short for のだ) shows the speaker has just found something out. かえしてるんだー = 'so you've hatched them'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows something done up to now; てる is the short spoken form. かえしてる = 'have hatched'.
